resources.string: Reads text aloud in Cantonese or English, entirely on this phone.
Type or paste what to read aloud
Other apps can read aloud with it too: choose ggtts as the text-to-speech engine in Android\'s settings.
1. Get a voice\'s model files on this phone (about 2.5 GB; android/README.md in the ggtts repository says where).
2. Press \"Import a model file\" and pick each one.
3. Choose the files below and press Speak.
Import a voice\'s model files from the ⋮ menu
First sound in about %1$s s on a Galaxy Z Fold5
+ Add a voice from a file
Type or paste a passage and listen to it read in a natural voice. Nothing you type leaves the phone: the app has no permission to use the internet.
It is slow. The first sound takes %1$s seconds with a Cantonese voice and %2$s with an English one, so it suits listening to a passage you have chosen, not reading the screen as you go.
Other apps can use it too: it is a text-to-speech engine in Android\'s settings.
No model ships with this app. Model files are read from:\n%1$s
Codec (Qwen3-TTS 12 Hz codec, or Kitten-TTS 2 S3Gen)
Voice file (Kitten-TTS 2 only: the prepared voice JSON)
Speak through Android\'s TTS (ggtts as the engine)

Needs %1$.1f GB of model files and about %2$.1f GB of memory. On %3$s, the first audio takes %4$s s, then each second of speech takes %5$s s to render. Not suitable for screen readers or anything interactive.
